issues: The job requests a GPU but does not explicitly request any CPU resources via `--cpus-per-task`. Flux will likely default to allocating a single CPU core. This can create a significant performance bottleneck, as the CPU may be unable to keep the GPU fed with data, leading to underutilization of the expensive GPU resource. It is recommended to explicitly request a reasonable number of CPUs (e.g., `--cpus-per-task=8`) to support the GPU workload.

The script specifies absolute paths for its output and error files (e.g., `/tigress/ahoag/cnn/exp2/slurm_logs/...`). However, it does not ensure that the target directory (`slurm_logs`) exists. If this directory is not present before the job starts, the job will fail immediately because it cannot create its log files.
